decisions.choice: gather yourselves together: come together, perhaps "gather like stubble"
decisions.reason: The verb is used for gathering straw or stubble (Exodus 5:7, 12), and is related to the word for stubble. Doubling it gives urgency, and it may also hint at what the nation is: stubble, soon to be blown away like the chaff of verse 2. The sense of the call is plain: assemble, as for a fast or an assembly of repentance (Joel 2:15-16), before it is too late.

decisions.choice: nation without shame: a nation that feels no shame
decisions.reason: The verb usually means "long for" (Genesis 31:30; Psalm 84:3), which would give "a nation that is not desired" or "that has no longing". In later Hebrew and Aramaic a related word means "be pale" with shame, and that sense fits the call to humble themselves in verse 3.

decisions.choice: the nation: Judah
alternatives: the Philistines and the other nations named after
decisions.reason: The oracles against the nations begin in verse 4. The call here, and the call to seek the LORD in verse 3, are addressed to Judah, the people threatened in chapter 1, while there is still time. |

decisions.choice: without shame (L, B); that has no shame (R)
decisions.reason: The levels follow the meaning chosen in m2; the footnote gives the other. Readable ends the verse with a full stop and begins verse 2 with "Do it", to keep its sentences short. |

decisions.choice: plural commands with plural_you to "the nation"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew commands are plural, spoken to the people of the nation, so Spanish uses the plural with the plural_you setting, while the vocative "nación" stays singular.

decisions.choice: verse 1 closes as its own sentence; verse 2 opens with "[Hãy làm vậy]" (L) / "Hãy làm vậy" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew call runs on into the three "before" clauses of verse 2. Vietnamese closes each verse as its own sentence, so verse 2 repeats the call, in brackets at Literal, as the English Readable does ("Do it before").

decisions.choice: verse 1 ends as its own sentence; verse 2 ends with the call again ("[모여라]" L, "그렇게 하여라" B, "모여라" R)
decisions.reason: Korean puts the verb last, so the three "before" clauses of verse 2 need a verb of their own; each verse closes as its own sentence.

en.L: before the decree gives birth, \q like chaff the day passes by; \q before there comes upon you the burning anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q before there comes upon you the day of the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: before the decree takes effect \q and the day blows away like chaff, \q before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s fierce anger falls on you, \q before the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s anger overtakes you.
en.R: Do it before what God has decided comes to pass, \q before your time blows away like chaff. \q Do it before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s fierce anger comes on you, \q before the day when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} shows {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger.

vi.L: [Hãy làm vậy] trước khi sắc lệnh sinh ra, \q ngày qua đi như trấu; \q trước khi cơn giận phừng phừng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến trên các ngươi, \q trước khi ngày thịnh nộ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến trên các ngươi.

ko.L: 작정된 일이 태어나기 전에, \q 그날이 겨처럼 지나가기 전에, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 맹렬한 분노가 너희에게 닥치기 전에, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 분노의 날이 너희에게 닥치기 전에 [모여라].
ko.B: 작정된 일이 이루어지기 전에, \q 그날이 겨처럼 날아가 버리기 전에, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 맹렬한 분노가 너희에게 내리기 전에, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 진노하시는 날이 너희에게 닥치기 전에 그렇게 하여라.
ko.R: 하나님께서 정하신 일이 일어나기 전에, \q 너희의 시간이 겨처럼 날아가 버리기 전에 모여라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 무서운 분노가 너희에게 내리기 전에, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 분노를 쏟으시는 날이 오기 전에 모여라.

decisions.choice: before the decree gives birth, like chaff the day passes by: before God's decision is carried out and the time runs out
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is hard and reads like a broken line. "Gives birth" pictures the decree of judgment bringing forth what it holds, as a pregnant woman gives birth. "Like chaff the day passes" seems to mean that the time left is being blown away as chaff is blown off the threshing floor. The ancient translations read the line in different ways, and some suggest small changes to the text; the sense of urgency is clear either way.

decisions.choice: the burning of the anger of the LORD: his fierce anger
decisions.reason: Anger in Hebrew is "heat of the nose", and "burning" makes it stronger still. The phrase is common (Jeremiah 4:8; Nahum 1:6). |

decisions.choice: three times "before": the call is urgent
decisions.reason: The verse repeats "before" three times, each time nearer to the day itself. The call to gather in verse 1 and to seek the LORD in verse 3 must be answered before the day comes. |

decisions.choice: takes effect (B); comes to pass (R); gives birth (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of birth. Balanced and Readable say what it means (m1). Readable names God as the one who decided, which the verse implies. |

decisions.choice: "{{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}" for "upon you"; Readable "{{plural_you:Háganlo|Hacedlo}}"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" is plural, the people of the nation called in verse 1, so each "you" takes the plural_you setting.

source.text: בַּקְּשׁ֤וּ אֶת־יְהוָה֙ כָּל־עַנְוֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִשְׁפָּט֖וֹ פָּעָ֑לוּ בַּקְּשׁוּ־צֶ֨דֶק֙ בַּקְּשׁ֣וּ עֲנָוָ֔ה אוּלַי֙ תִּסָּ֣תְר֔וּ בְּי֖וֹם אַף־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Seek Yahweh, all [the] humble of the land who have done his justice; seek righteousness, seek humility; perhaps you will be hidden on [the] day of [the] anger of Yahweh.

en.L: Seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all you humble of the land, \q who have done {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} justice; \q seek righteousness, seek humility; \q perhaps you will be hidden \q on the day of the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all you humble people of the land, \q you who carry out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commands. \q Seek righteousness; seek humility. \q It may be that you will find shelter \q on the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s anger.
en.R: Turn to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all you humble people of the land, \q you who obey {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} laws. \q Try hard to do what is right and to be humble. \q Then perhaps you will be kept safe \q on the day when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} shows {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger.

es.L: {{plural_you:Busquen|Buscad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todos los humildes de la tierra, \q que han practicado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecho; \q {{plural_you:busquen|buscad}} la justicia, {{plural_you:busquen|buscad}} la humildad; \q quizá {{plural_you:serán escondidos|seréis escondidos}} \q en el día de la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Busquen|Buscad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los humildes de la tierra, \q que cumplen {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandatos. \q {{plural_you:Busquen|Buscad}} la justicia; {{plural_you:busquen|buscad}} la humildad. \q Tal vez {{plural_you:encuentren|encontréis}} refugio \q en el día de la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Vuélvanse|Volveos}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todos los humildes de la tierra, \q {{plural_you:ustedes que obedecen|vosotros que obedecéis}} {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} leyes. \q {{plural_you:Esfuércense|Esforzaos}} por hacer lo que es justo y por ser humildes. \q Así tal vez {{plural_you:estarán|estaréis}} a salvo \q el día en que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} muestre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} enojo.

fr.L: Cherchez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, tous les humbles du pays, \q vous qui avez accompli {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} jugement ; \q cherchez la justice, cherchez l’humilité ; \q peut-être serez-vous mis à l’abri \q au jour de la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Cherchez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous tous, les humbles du pays, \q vous qui mettez en pratique {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements. \q Recherchez ce qui est juste ; recherchez l’humilité. \q Il se peut que vous trouviez un abri \q au jour de la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Tournez-vous vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous tous, les humbles du pays, \q vous qui obéissez à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lois. \q Efforcez-vous de faire ce qui est juste et d’être humbles. \q Alors vous serez peut-être protégés \q le jour où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} montrera {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère.

sw.L: Mtafuteni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninyi nyote wapole wa nchi, \q mlioitekeleza hukumu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; \q utafuteni uadilifu, utafuteni upole; \q labda mtafichwa \q siku ya hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mtafuteni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninyi nyote wapole wa nchi, \q mnaozitekeleza amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. \q Utafuteni uadilifu; utafuteni upole. \q Huenda mkapata mahali pa kujificha \q siku ya hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Mrudieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninyi nyote watu wanyenyekevu wa nchi, \q mnaozitii sheria {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. \q Jitahidini kutenda yaliyo haki na kuwa wanyenyekevu. \q Huenda mkalindwa salama \q siku ile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakapoonyesha hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: Hãy tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi tất cả những người khiêm nhu trong xứ, \q là những người đã thi hành công lý của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q hãy tìm kiếm sự công chính, hãy tìm kiếm sự khiêm nhu; \q có lẽ anh em sẽ được giấu kín \q trong ngày thịnh nộ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Hãy tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi tất cả những người khiêm nhu trong xứ, \q là những người làm theo các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Hãy tìm kiếm sự công chính; hãy tìm kiếm sự khiêm nhu. \q Biết đâu anh em sẽ được che chở \q trong ngày thịnh nộ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Hãy quay về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi tất cả những người khiêm nhường trong xứ, \q là những người vâng giữ luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Hãy cố gắng làm điều ngay thẳng và sống khiêm nhường. \q Biết đâu anh em sẽ được giữ an toàn \q trong ngày {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tỏ cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾아라, 그 땅의 모든 겸손한 자들아, \q 그분의 법도를 행한 자들아. \q 의를 찾고, 겸손을 찾아라. \q 혹시 너희가 숨겨질지도 모른다, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 분노의 날에.
ko.B: 이 땅의 모든 겸손한 사람들아, \q 그분의 명령을 지키는 사람들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾아라. \q 의를 찾고 겸손을 찾아라. \q 그러면 혹시 너희가 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 분노하시는 날에 피할 곳을 얻을지도 모른다.
ko.R: 이 땅의 겸손한 사람들아, \q 그분의 법을 지키는 사람들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아오너라. \q 옳은 일을 하고 겸손하게 살려고 힘써라. \q 그러면 혹시 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 분노를 쏟으시는 날에 너희가 안전하게 보호받을지도 모른다.

decisions.choice: the humble of the land: the lowly, who depend on God
decisions.reason: The word means the poor and lowly, and often those who, having no power of their own, look to God (Isaiah 11:4; Psalm 37:11; Amos 2:7). In 3:12 the LORD promises to leave in Jerusalem "a people humble and lowly". Jesus' blessing on the meek who will inherit the earth (Matthew 5:5) takes up Psalm 37:11. |

decisions.choice: who have done his justice: who keep his commands
decisions.reason: "His justice" is what he has decided is right, his rulings and laws (Jeremiah 5:4-5; 8:7). Those who do it live by his law. Even they are told to go on seeking. |

decisions.choice: perhaps you will be hidden: perhaps the LORD will shelter you
decisions.reason: "Perhaps" leaves the rescue in God's hands, as in Joel 2:14 ("Who knows? He may turn") and Amos 5:15. Being hidden means being kept safe in time of danger (Psalm 27:5). There is a play on the prophet's name, Zephaniah, which means "the LORD has hidden" or "the LORD protects". |

decisions.choice: righteousness (L, B); to do what is right (R); his commands (B), his laws (R)
decisions.reason: Righteousness here is right living as God requires. Readable says "what is right", as the Amos table does. Balanced and Readable say "commands" and "laws" for "his justice" (m2). Readable says "Turn to" for "Seek", as elsewhere in the prophets. |

decisions.choice: "los humildes de la tierra"; plural commands with plural_you
decisions.reason: The humble are addressed together, so every command and "you" takes the plural_you setting. Literal says "derecho" for "his justice", as the prophets' Spanish does for mishpat.

decisions.choice: "son jugement" (L), "ses commandements" (B), "ses lois" (R)
decisions.reason: "His justice" here is what the LORD has ruled is right (m2); Literal keeps a single noun, and Balanced and Readable name his commands, as the English does. The line was kept away from the familiar French wording of this verse.

decisions.choice: "wapole" (L, B), "wanyenyekevu" (R); "uadilifu" for righteousness (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Wapole" is the word of Matthew 5:5 for the meek who inherit the earth, which takes up the same Hebrew idea (m1); Readable says the plainer "wanyenyekevu". "Uadilifu" for right living follows Isaiah 28:17 B. The verse was drafted from the Hebrew and kept away from the Union Version's wording.

decisions.choice: "anh em" for the humble
decisions.reason: Here the prophet pleads with the humble in his own voice, so he calls them "anh em", as the terms sheet sets for a prophet's plea, not the oracle's "các ngươi" of rebuke used in verse 2.

decisions.choice: "그분의 법도" (L), "그분의 명령" (B), "그분의 법" (R); the prophet speaks of God with -시-
decisions.reason: The prophet speaks about the LORD here, so the LORD takes 께서 and -시-. "His justice" (m2) is 법도, the Pentateuch word for mishpat, at Literal.

source.text: כִּ֤י עַזָּה֙ עֲזוּבָ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ה וְאַשְׁקְל֖וֹן לִשְׁמָמָ֑ה אַשְׁדּ֗וֹד בַּֽצָּהֳרַ֨יִם֙ יְגָ֣רְשׁ֔וּהָ וְעֶקְר֖וֹן תֵּעָקֵֽר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For Gaza will be abandoned, and Ashkelon [will become] a desolation; Ashdod, at noon they will drive her out, and Ekron will be uprooted.

en.L: For Gaza will be abandoned, \q and Ashkelon [will become] a desolation; \q Ashdod they will drive out at noon, \q and Ekron will be uprooted.
en.B: For Gaza will be deserted \q and Ashkelon left in ruins; \q Ashdod's people will be driven out at noon, \q and Ekron will be torn up by the roots.
en.R: Gaza will be left empty, \q and Ashkelon will be destroyed. \q The people of Ashdod will be driven out in the middle of the day, \q and Ekron will be pulled up by its roots.

es.L: Porque Gaza será abandonada, \q y Ascalón [será] una desolación; \q a Asdod la echarán a mediodía, \q y Ecrón será desarraigada.
es.B: Porque Gaza quedará desierta \q y Ascalón en ruinas; \q a la gente de Asdod la echarán a mediodía, \q y Ecrón será arrancada de raíz.
es.R: Gaza quedará vacía, \q y Ascalón será destruida. \q A la gente de Asdod la echarán en pleno día, \q y Ecrón será arrancada de raíz.

fr.L: Car Gaza sera abandonnée, \q et Ashqelôn [deviendra] une désolation ; \q Ashdod, on la chassera en plein midi, \q et Eqrôn sera déracinée.
fr.B: Car Gaza sera désertée \q et Ashqelôn laissée en ruine ; \q les habitants d’Ashdod seront chassés à midi, \q et Eqrôn sera arrachée jusqu’aux racines.
fr.R: Gaza sera vidée de ses habitants, \q et Ashqelôn sera détruite. \q Les gens d’Ashdod seront chassés au milieu de la journée, \q et Eqrôn sera arrachée avec ses racines.

sw.L: Kwa maana Gaza itaachwa, \q na Ashkeloni [itakuwa] ukiwa; \q Ashdodi wataifukuza adhuhuri, \q na Ekroni itang'olewa.
sw.B: Kwa maana Gaza itahamwa \q na Ashkeloni itaachwa magofu; \q watu wa Ashdodi watafukuzwa adhuhuri, \q na Ekroni itang'olewa pamoja na mizizi yake.
sw.R: Gaza itaachwa tupu, \q na Ashkeloni itaharibiwa. \q Watu wa Ashdodi watafukuzwa katikati ya mchana, \q na Ekroni itang'olewa kwa mizizi yake.

vi.L: Vì Ga-xa sẽ bị bỏ hoang, \q và Ách-ca-lôn [sẽ thành] hoang vu; \q Ách-đốt, người ta sẽ đuổi nó đi giữa trưa, \q và Éc-rôn sẽ bị nhổ rễ.
vi.B: Vì Ga-xa sẽ bị bỏ trống \q và Ách-ca-lôn bị bỏ hoang tàn; \q dân Ách-đốt sẽ bị đuổi đi giữa ban trưa, \q và Éc-rôn sẽ bị nhổ tận gốc.
vi.R: Ga-xa sẽ bị bỏ trống, \q và Ách-ca-lôn sẽ bị tiêu diệt. \q Dân Ách-đốt sẽ bị đuổi đi giữa ban ngày, \q và Éc-rôn sẽ bị nhổ bật cả rễ.

ko.L: 참으로 가사는 버림을 받고, \q 아스글론은 황폐하게 [될 것이다]. \q 아스돗은 대낮에 쫓겨나고, \q 에그론은 뿌리째 뽑힐 것이다.
ko.B: 가사는 버려지고 \q 아스글론은 폐허가 될 것이다. \q 아스돗 사람들은 한낮에 쫓겨나고, \q 에그론은 뿌리째 뽑힐 것이다.
ko.R: 가사는 텅 비게 되고, \q 아스글론은 망할 것이다. \q 아스돗 사람들은 한낮에 쫓겨날 것이다. \q 에그론은 뿌리째 뽑힐 것이다.

decisions.choice: Gaza abandoned, Ekron uprooted: plays on the names
decisions.reason: In Hebrew, "Gaza" ('azzah) and "abandoned" ('azuvah) sound alike, and so do "Ekron" ('eqron) and "uprooted" (te'aqer). Each city's name foretells its fate. The play cannot be kept in translation.

decisions.choice: Gaza, Ashkelon, Ashdod, Ekron: four of the five cities of the Philistines
decisions.reason: The Philistines lived on the coastal plain west of Judah, in five chief cities (Joshua 13:3). Gath, the fifth, is missing here, as in Amos 1:6-8 and Jeremiah 25:20; it may have lost its importance by then. |

decisions.choice: at noon: suddenly, in broad daylight
decisions.reason: Armies usually attacked at dawn. An attack at noon, during the hot hour of rest, would come when no one expected it (Jeremiah 6:4; 15:8). It may also mean that the city falls in half a day.

decisions.choice: in the middle of the day (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "in the middle of the day" for "at noon". |

decisions.choice: "Gaza, Ascalón, Asdod, Ecrón"
decisions.reason: The names published in Amos 1:6-8.

decisions.choice: "Gaza, Ashqelôn, Ashdod, Eqrôn"
decisions.reason: The names published in Amos 1:6-8.

decisions.choice: "Gaza, Ashkeloni, Ashdodi, Ekroni"
decisions.reason: The names published in Amos 1:6-8. The play on Gaza and Ekron (m1) cannot be kept in Swahili.

decisions.choice: "Ga-xa, Ách-ca-lôn, Ách-đốt, Éc-rôn"
decisions.reason: The names published in Amos 1:6-8.

decisions.choice: "가사, 아스글론, 아스돗, 에그론"
decisions.reason: The names published in Amos 1:6-8.

source.text: ה֗וֹי יֹֽשְׁבֵ֛י חֶ֥בֶל הַיָּ֖ם גּ֣וֹי כְּרֵתִ֑ים דְּבַר־יְהוָ֣ה עֲלֵיכֶ֗ם כְּנַ֨עַן֙ אֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֖יךְ מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃

records.literal_gloss: Woe [to the] inhabitants of the region of the sea, [the] nation of [the] Cherethites! [The] word of Yahweh [is] against you, Canaan, land of [the] Philistines, and I will destroy you until there is no inhabitant.

en.L: Woe, inhabitants of the seacoast, nation of Cherethites! \q The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is against you, Canaan, land of the Philistines; \q and I will destroy you until no inhabitant [is left].
en.B: Woe to you who live by the sea, you nation of Cherethites! \q The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is against you, Canaan, land of the Philistines: \q I will destroy you until no one is left.
en.R: How terrible it will be for you who live along the sea, you Cherethites! \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken against you, Canaan, land of the Philistines: \q I will destroy you until no one is left.

es.L: ¡Ay de los habitantes de la costa del mar, nación de cereteos! \q La palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [es] contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, Canaán, tierra de los filisteos; \q y te destruiré hasta que no quede habitante.
es.B: ¡Ay de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que viven junto al mar, nación de cereteos! \q La palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} está contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, Canaán, tierra de los filisteos: \q Te destruiré hasta que no quede nadie.
es.R: ¡Qué terrible será para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que viven a lo largo del mar, cereteos! \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hablado contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, Canaán, tierra de los filisteos: \q Te destruiré hasta que no quede nadie.

fr.L: Malheur, habitants de la côte de la mer, nation des Kéréthiens ! \q La parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [est] contre vous, Canaan, pays des Philistins ; \q et je te ferai périr jusqu’à ce qu’il ne reste plus d’habitant.
fr.B: Malheur à vous qui habitez au bord de la mer, nation des Kéréthiens ! \q La parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est contre vous, Canaan, pays des Philistins : \q Je te détruirai jusqu’à ce qu’il ne reste personne.
fr.R: Quel malheur pour vous qui vivez le long de la mer, vous les Kéréthiens ! \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a parlé contre vous, Canaan, pays des Philistins : \q Je te détruirai jusqu’à ce qu’il ne reste plus personne.

sw.L: Ole, wakaaji wa pwani ya bahari, taifa la Wakerethi! \q Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [li] dhidi yenu, Kanaani, nchi ya Wafilisti; \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitakuangamiza hata asibaki mkaaji.
sw.B: Ole wenu ninyi mnaoishi kando ya bahari, taifa la Wakerethi! \q Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} liko dhidi yenu, Kanaani, nchi ya Wafilisti: \q Nitakuangamiza hata asibaki mtu.
sw.R: Itakuwa vibaya sana kwenu mnaoishi kando ya bahari, enyi Wakerethi! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema dhidi yenu, Kanaani, nchi ya Wafilisti: \q Nitakuangamiza hata asibaki mtu yeyote.

vi.L: Khốn cho cư dân miền duyên hải, dân tộc Kê-rê-thít! \q Lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghịch cùng các ngươi, hỡi Ca-na-an, xứ của người Phi-li-tin; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hủy diệt ngươi cho đến khi không còn cư dân nào.
vi.B: Khốn cho các ngươi là những kẻ sống ven biển, hỡi dân tộc Kê-rê-thít! \q Lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghịch cùng các ngươi, hỡi Ca-na-an, xứ của người Phi-li-tin: \q Ta sẽ hủy diệt ngươi cho đến khi không còn một ai.
vi.R: Thật khốn khổ cho các ngươi là những kẻ sống dọc bờ biển, hỡi người Kê-rê-thít! \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán nghịch cùng các ngươi, hỡi Ca-na-an, xứ của người Phi-li-tin: \q Ta sẽ hủy diệt ngươi cho đến khi không còn một ai.

ko.L: 바닷가에 사는 주민들, 그렛 민족에게 화가 있다! \q 블레셋 사람들의 땅 가나안아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 너희를 대적한다. \q 내가 너를 멸하여 주민이 하나도 없게 하겠다.
ko.B: 바닷가에 사는 자들아, 그렛 민족아, 너희에게 화가 있다! \q 블레셋 사람들의 땅 가나안아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 너희를 치려고 한다. \q 내가 너를 멸하여 한 사람도 남지 않게 하겠다.
ko.R: 바닷가를 따라 사는 그렛 사람들아, 너희에게 끔찍한 일이 닥칠 것이다! \q 블레셋 사람들의 땅 가나안아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희를 두고 말씀하셨다. \q 내가 너를 멸하여 한 사람도 남지 않게 하겠다.

decisions.choice: the Cherethites: a people from Crete, part of the Philistines
decisions.reason: The Cherethites are named beside the Philistines in 1 Samuel 30:14 and Ezekiel 25:16, and David's bodyguard included Cherethites (2 Samuel 8:18). The name is generally linked with Crete, from which, with Caphtor, the Philistines came (Amos 9:7; Jeremiah 47:4). |

decisions.choice: Canaan, land of the Philistines: the coastal part of Canaan
decisions.reason: Canaan is the name of the whole land west of the Jordan. The Philistine coast was part of it (Joshua 13:3). Calling the Philistines "Canaan" may also recall that Canaan's people were to be driven out. |

decisions.choice: and I will destroy you: the LORD's own words
decisions.reason: After "the word of the LORD is against you", the LORD himself speaks. The word that is against them is the word that follows. |

decisions.choice: Woe (L), Woe to (B), How terrible it will be for (R)
decisions.reason: The cry follows the Isaiah table for hoy. Balanced and Readable put a colon before the LORD's words. |

decisions.choice: "¡Ay de ...!" (L, B), "¡Qué terrible será para ...!" (R); "cereteos"; plural "ustedes", then singular "te"
decisions.reason: The cry follows the Isaiah wording for hoy, and "cereteos" is the form published in Ezekiel 25:16. The Hebrew "against you" is plural, the people of the coast, and "I will destroy you" is singular, Canaan the land; Spanish follows the switch.

decisions.choice: "Malheur, ..." (L), "Malheur à ..." (B), "Quel malheur pour ... !" (R); "les Kéréthiens"; "vous", then "te"
decisions.reason: The cry follows the Isaiah table for hoy, and "Kéréthiens" is the form published in Ezekiel 25:16. French follows the Hebrew switch from plural "vous" to singular "te" for Canaan.

decisions.choice: "Ole, ..." (L), "Ole wenu" (B), "Itakuwa vibaya sana kwenu" (R); "Wakerethi"
decisions.reason: The cry follows the Isaiah table for hoy, in the second person because the coast is addressed; "Wakerethi" is the form published in Ezekiel 25:16. Swahili follows the switch from plural "yenu" to singular "-ku-" for Canaan.

decisions.choice: "Khốn cho" (L, B), "Thật khốn khổ cho" (R); "người Kê-rê-thít"; "các ngươi", then "ngươi"
decisions.reason: The cry follows the Isaiah table for hoy, and "Kê-rê-thít" is the form published in Ezekiel 25:16. Vietnamese follows the Hebrew switch from plural to singular for Canaan.

decisions.choice: "화가 있다" (L, B), "끔찍한 일이 닥칠 것이다" (R); "그렛 사람들"
decisions.reason: The cry follows the Isaiah wording for hoy, and 그렛 is the form published in Ezekiel 25:16. Korean follows the Hebrew switch from 너희 to 너 for Canaan; the vocative is placed before the clause, as Korean prefers.

source.text: וְֽהָיְתָ֞ה חֶ֣בֶל הַיָּ֗ם נְוֺ֛ת כְּרֹ֥ת רֹעִ֖ים וְגִדְר֥וֹת צֹֽאן׃

records.literal_gloss: And the region of the sea will become pastures, meadows of shepherds and folds of flocks.

en.L: And the seacoast will become pastures, meadows for shepherds and folds for flocks.
en.B: The land by the sea will become pastureland, with meadows for shepherds and pens for sheep.
en.R: The land by the sea will become grassland, with shepherds' camps and pens for sheep.

es.L: Y la costa del mar será pastizales, praderas de pastores y rediles de ovejas.
es.B: La tierra junto al mar se convertirá en pastizal, con praderas para los pastores y corrales para las ovejas.
es.R: La tierra junto al mar se volverá campo de pasto, con campamentos de pastores y corrales para las ovejas.

fr.L: Et la côte de la mer deviendra des pâturages, des prairies de bergers et des enclos de troupeaux.
fr.B: Le pays du bord de mer deviendra une terre de pâture, avec des prairies pour les bergers et des enclos pour les moutons.
fr.R: La région du bord de mer deviendra une terre d’herbe, avec des campements de bergers et des enclos pour les moutons.

sw.L: Na pwani ya bahari itakuwa malisho, mbuga za wachungaji na mazizi ya makundi.
sw.B: Nchi ya pwani itakuwa nchi ya malisho, yenye mbuga za wachungaji na mazizi ya kondoo.
sw.R: Nchi iliyo kando ya bahari itakuwa nchi ya majani, yenye kambi za wachungaji na mazizi ya kondoo.

vi.L: Và miền duyên hải sẽ thành đồng cỏ, bãi chăn của người chăn và chuồng của bầy chiên.
vi.B: Vùng đất ven biển sẽ thành đồng cỏ, có bãi chăn cho người chăn và chuồng cho chiên.
vi.R: Vùng đất ven biển sẽ thành đồng cỏ, có lều trại của người chăn và chuồng chiên.

ko.L: 그리고 바닷가는 목초지, 목자들의 풀밭, 양 떼의 우리가 될 것이다.
ko.B: 바닷가 땅은 목초지가 되어, 목자들의 풀밭과 양 우리가 있을 것이다.
ko.R: 바닷가 땅은 풀밭이 되고, 거기에 목자들의 천막과 양 우리가 있을 것이다.

decisions.choice: meadows: open grazing ground, or perhaps shepherds' caves or wells
decisions.reason: The word is rare and its meaning uncertain. It may be related to the words for "dig", giving caves or wells, or to a word for a grassy field. It also sounds like the name of the Cherethites in verse 5: the land of the Cherethites becomes a land of shepherds' grounds.

decisions.choice: the crowded coast becomes grazing land
decisions.reason: The cities of the Philistines will be empty, and shepherds will graze their flocks where the towns stood. Verse 7 says whose flocks they will be. |

decisions.choice: shepherds' camps (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "camps" for the places where shepherds stay with their flocks, leaving the uncertain word general (m1).

source.text: וְהָ֣יָה חֶ֗בֶל לִשְׁאֵרִ֛ית בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם יִרְע֑וּן בְּבָתֵּ֣י אַשְׁקְל֗וֹן בָּעֶ֨רֶב֙ יִרְבָּצ֔וּן כִּ֧י יִפְקְדֵ֛ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם וְשָׁ֥ב שְׁבִיתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] region will belong to [the] remnant of [the] house of Judah; on them they will graze; in [the] houses of Ashkelon in the evening they will lie down; for Yahweh their God will visit them and restore their fortunes.

en.L: And the region will be for the remnant of the house of Judah; on them they will graze; \q in the houses of Ashkelon in the evening they will lie down; \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God will visit them and restore their fortunes.
en.B: The coast will belong to what is left of the house of Judah; there they will pasture their flocks. \q In the evening they will lie down in the houses of Ashkelon, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God will care for them and restore their fortunes.
en.R: The land by the sea will belong to the people of Judah who are left alive. They will feed their flocks there. \q In the evening they will rest in the houses of Ashkelon. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} their God will take care of them and make things good for them again.

es.L: Y la región será para el remanente de la casa de Judá; sobre ellas apacentarán; \q en las casas de Ascalón al atardecer se acostarán; \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios los visitará y restaurará su suerte.
es.B: La costa será para el remanente de la casa de Judá; allí apacentarán sus rebaños. \q Al anochecer se acostarán en las casas de Ascalón, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios cuidará de ellos y restaurará su suerte.
es.R: La tierra junto al mar será de la gente de Judá que quede con vida. Allí apacentarán sus rebaños. \q Al anochecer descansarán en las casas de Ascalón. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios cuidará de ellos y hará que todo les vuelva a ir bien.

fr.L: Et la région sera pour le reste de la maison de Juda ; sur eux ils feront paître ; \q dans les maisons d’Ashqelôn, le soir, ils se coucheront ; \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu les visitera et rétablira leur sort.
fr.B: La côte appartiendra au reste de la maison de Juda ; c’est là qu’ils feront paître leurs troupeaux. \q Le soir, ils se coucheront dans les maisons d’Ashqelôn, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu prendra soin d’eux et rétablira leur sort.
fr.R: La région du bord de mer appartiendra aux gens de Juda qui seront restés en vie. Ils y feront paître leurs troupeaux. \q Le soir, ils se reposeront dans les maisons d’Ashqelôn. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu prendra soin d’eux et les rendra de nouveau heureux.

sw.L: Na eneo hilo litakuwa la mabaki ya nyumba ya Yuda; juu yake watalisha; \q katika nyumba za Ashkeloni jioni watalala; \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao atawajilia na kuwarudishia mafanikio yao.
sw.B: Pwani itakuwa mali ya mabaki ya nyumba ya Yuda; huko watachunga makundi yao. \q Jioni watalala katika nyumba za Ashkeloni, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao atawatunza na kuwarudishia mafanikio yao.
sw.R: Nchi ya pwani itakuwa mali ya watu wa Yuda waliobaki hai. Watachunga makundi yao huko. \q Jioni watapumzika katika nyumba za Ashkeloni. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao atawatunza na kuyafanya mambo yao kuwa mema tena.

vi.L: Và miền ấy sẽ thuộc về những người sót lại của nhà Giu-đa; họ sẽ chăn bầy trên đó; \q chiều tối họ sẽ nằm nghỉ trong các nhà ở Ách-ca-lôn; \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ sẽ thăm viếng họ và phục hồi cơ đồ họ.
vi.B: Miền duyên hải sẽ thuộc về những người sót lại của nhà Giu-đa; họ sẽ chăn bầy ở đó. \q Chiều tối họ sẽ nằm nghỉ trong các nhà ở Ách-ca-lôn, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ sẽ chăm sóc họ và phục hồi cơ đồ họ.
vi.R: Vùng đất ven biển sẽ thuộc về những người Giu-đa còn sống sót. Họ sẽ chăn bầy ở đó. \q Chiều tối họ sẽ nghỉ ngơi trong các nhà ở Ách-ca-lôn. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ sẽ chăm sóc họ và làm cho họ được thịnh vượng trở lại.

ko.L: 그 지역은 유다 집의 남은 자의 것이 되어, 그들이 그 위에서 [양 떼를] 먹일 것이다. \q 저녁에는 그들이 아스글론의 집들에 누울 것이다. \q 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 돌보시고 그들의 운명을 돌이키실 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그 바닷가는 유다 집의 남은 사람들의 것이 되어, 그들이 거기서 양 떼를 먹일 것이다. \q 저녁이면 그들이 아스글론의 집들에서 누워 쉴 것이다. \q 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 돌보시고 그들의 형편을 회복시키실 것이기 때문이다.
ko.R: 바닷가 땅은 살아남은 유다 사람들의 것이 될 것이다. 그들은 거기서 양 떼를 먹일 것이다. \q 저녁이면 그들은 아스글론의 집들에서 쉴 것이다. \q 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 돌보시고 다시 잘되게 해 주실 것이다.

decisions.choice: the remnant of the house of Judah: those of Judah who survive the judgment
decisions.reason: The prophets speak of a remnant who come through the judgment and receive the promises (Isaiah 10:20-22; Micah 2:12). In Zephaniah they are the humble people of 2:3 and 3:12-13. |

decisions.choice: will visit them: will come to care for them
decisions.reason: The same verb that means "punish" in 1:8-9 here means to attend to someone for good, as when God "visited" his people in Egypt (Genesis 50:24; Exodus 4:31; Ruth 1:6). |

decisions.choice: restore their fortunes: give back what they lost
decisions.reason: The phrase, "turn the turning", is used of restoring a people's former prosperity (Job 42:10; Jeremiah 30:3) and of bringing back exiles. The Hebrew text has two spellings here, one read as "captivity" and the other as "fortunes"; both senses fit a promise to a remnant.

decisions.choice: restore their fortunes (L, B); make things good for them again (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase follows the Jeremiah table. "On them" (L) refers to the pastures of verse 6; Balanced and Readable say "there". |

decisions.choice: "el remanente" (L, B), "la gente de Judá que quede con vida" (R); "restaurará su suerte" (L, B), "hará que todo les vuelva a ir bien" (R)
decisions.reason: The remnant and "restore the fortunes" follow the wording set for the Spanish prophets.

decisions.choice: "le reste" (L, B); "rétablira leur sort" (L, B), "les rendra de nouveau heureux" (R)
decisions.reason: The remnant and "restore the fortunes" follow the wording set for the French prophets.

decisions.choice: "mabaki" (L, B), "waliobaki hai" (R); "kuwarudishia mafanikio" (L, B), "kuyafanya mambo yao kuwa mema tena" (R)
decisions.reason: The remnant and "restore the fortunes" follow the wording set for the Swahili prophets.

decisions.choice: "những người sót lại" (L, B), "còn sống sót" (R); "phục hồi cơ đồ" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The remnant and "restore the fortunes" follow the wording set for the Vietnamese prophets; Readable says it plainly, as the English Readable does. "Thăm viếng" at Literal keeps the verb of 1:8-9 (m2).

decisions.choice: "남은 자" (L), "남은 사람들" (B), "살아남은 사람들" (R); "운명을 돌이키다" / "형편을 회복시키다" / "다시 잘되게 해 주다"
decisions.reason: The remnant and "restore the fortunes" follow the wording set for the Korean prophets. The prophet speaks about the LORD here, so he takes 께서 and -시-.

source.text: שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי֙ חֶרְפַּ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב וְגִדּוּפֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן אֲשֶׁ֤ר חֵֽרְפוּ֙ אֶת־עַמִּ֔י וַיַּגְדִּ֖ילוּ עַל־גְּבוּלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: I have heard [the] taunting of Moab and [the] revilings of [the] sons of Ammon, with which they have taunted my people and made [themselves] great against their territory.

en.L: I have heard the taunting of Moab \q and the revilings of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Ammon, \q with which they taunted {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people \q and made themselves great against their territory.
en.B: I have heard the taunts of Moab \q and the insults of the Ammonites, \q how they mocked {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people \q and made boasts against their land.
en.R: I have heard the people of Moab and Ammon \q insult and mock {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people. \q They have bragged that they would take their land.

es.L: He oído las burlas de Moab \q y los insultos de los hijos de Amón, \q con que escarnecieron a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo \q y se engrandecieron contra su territorio.
es.B: He oído las burlas de Moab \q y los insultos de los amonitas, \q cómo se mofaron de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo \q y se jactaron contra su tierra.
es.R: He oído a la gente de Moab y de Amón \q insultar a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo y burlarse de él. \q Se han jactado de que se quedarían con su tierra.

fr.L: J’ai entendu les outrages de Moab \q et les insultes des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Ammon, \q par lesquels ils ont outragé {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple \q et se sont grandis contre son territoire.
fr.B: J’ai entendu les railleries de Moab \q et les insultes des Ammonites, \q comment ils se sont moqués de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple \q et se sont vantés contre son pays.
fr.R: J’ai entendu les gens de Moab et d’Ammon \q insulter {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple et se moquer de lui. \q Ils se sont vantés de lui prendre son pays.

sw.L: Nimesikia dhihaka ya Moabu \q na matukano ya wana wa Amoni, \q ambayo kwayo waliwadhihaki watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} \q na kujikuza juu ya mipaka yao.
sw.B: Nimesikia dhihaka za Moabu \q na matusi ya Waamoni, \q jinsi walivyowadhihaki watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} \q na kujigamba juu ya nchi yao.
sw.R: Nimewasikia watu wa Moabu na Amoni \q wakiwatukana na kuwadhihaki watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. \q Wamejigamba kwamba wataichukua nchi yao.

vi.L: Ta đã nghe lời nhục mạ của Mô-áp \q và lời lăng mạ của con cái Am-môn, \q là những lời chúng đã dùng để nhục mạ dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} \q và tự tôn mình lên nghịch cùng bờ cõi của họ.
vi.B: Ta đã nghe những lời chế nhạo của Mô-áp \q và những lời sỉ nhục của người Am-môn, \q cách chúng nhạo báng dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} \q và khoe khoang nghịch cùng đất đai của họ.
vi.R: Ta đã nghe dân Mô-áp và dân Am-môn \q sỉ nhục và chế giễu dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Chúng đã khoe khoang rằng sẽ chiếm lấy đất của họ.

ko.L: 내가 모압의 비방과 \q 암몬 자손의 조롱을 들었다. \q 그들은 그것으로 내 백성을 비방하고 \q 그들의 영토를 두고 우쭐댔다.
ko.B: 나는 모압이 퍼붓는 비방과 \q 암몬 사람들이 내뱉는 모욕을 들었다. \q 그들은 내 백성을 조롱하고 \q 그들의 땅을 두고 큰소리를 쳤다.
ko.R: 나는 모압과 암몬 사람들이 \q 내 백성을 모욕하고 조롱하는 것을 들었다. \q 그들은 내 백성의 땅을 빼앗겠다고 큰소리쳤다.

decisions.choice: Moab and Ammon: Judah's neighbors east of the Jordan and the Dead Sea
decisions.reason: Moab and Ammon were related to Israel through Lot, Abraham's nephew (Genesis 19:36-38), but were often its enemies. The prophets condemn their cruelty and pride (Amos 1:13-2:3; Isaiah 15-16; Jeremiah 48:1-49:6; Ezekiel 25:1-11). Ezekiel 25:3, 6 says that Ammon rejoiced when the temple was ruined and Judah went into exile. |

decisions.choice: made themselves great against their territory: boasted against Judah's land, or took part of it
alternatives: enlarged their own borders at Judah's expense
decisions.reason: The verb means "make great", and with "against" it means to boast or act arrogantly against someone (Jeremiah 48:26; Ezekiel 35:13). With "their territory" it may also mean that they seized land, as Ammon did in Gilead (Amos 1:13).

decisions.choice: the children of Ammon (L, gender default), the Ammonites (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal follows Jeremiah 49:1 with the gender setting, since the people of Ammon, men and women, are meant. Balanced and Readable use the name of the people. |

decisions.choice: "los hijos de Amón" (L) with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "hijos" in the name of a people already includes women and men, as the Spanish terms sheet sets, so the English gender setting has nothing to change. Balanced and Readable use the name of the people.

decisions.choice: "les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Ammon" (L)
decisions.reason: French has two wordings here, as for "les enfants d'Israël", so Literal carries the English gender setting; Balanced and Readable use the name of the people.

decisions.choice: "wana wa Amoni" (L) with no gender span; "Waamoni" (B)
decisions.reason: "Wana" in the name of a people already includes women and men, so the gender setting has nothing to change in Swahili.

decisions.choice: "con cái Am-môn" (L) with no gender span; "người Am-môn" (B)
decisions.reason: "Con cái" already includes sons and daughters, so the gender setting has nothing to change in Vietnamese.

decisions.choice: "암몬 자손" (L), "암몬 사람들" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: 자손 already includes sons and daughters, so the gender setting has nothing to change in Korean.

source.text: לָכֵ֣ן חַי־אָ֡נִי נְאֻם֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כִּֽי־מוֹאָ֞ב כִּסְדֹ֤ם תִּֽהְיֶה֙ וּבְנֵ֤י עַמּוֹן֙ כַּֽעֲמֹרָ֔ה מִמְשַׁ֥ק חָר֛וּל וּמִכְרֵה־מֶ֥לַח וּשְׁמָמָ֖ה עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם שְׁאֵרִ֤ית עַמִּי֙ יְבָזּ֔וּם וְיֶ֥תֶר גּוֹיִ֖י יִנְחָלֽוּם׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore, [as] I live, declaration of Yahweh of hosts, God of Israel, surely Moab will be like Sodom and [the] sons of Ammon like Gomorrah, a place possessed by weeds and a pit of salt and a desolation forever; [the] remnant of my people will plunder them, and [the] rest of my nation will possess them.

en.L: Therefore, as I live, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, the God of Israel, Moab will surely be like Sodom and the {{gender:children|sons}} of Ammon like Gomorrah, \q a place possessed by weeds, and a pit of salt, and a desolation forever; \q the remnant of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people will plunder them, \q and the rest of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} nation will possess them.
en.B: Therefore, as I live, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, Moab will become like Sodom and the Ammonites like Gomorrah, \q a land overrun by weeds, a pit of salt, a wasteland forever. \q What is left of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people will plunder them; \q the survivors of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} nation will take their land.
en.R: So, as surely as I live, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, Moab and Ammon will be destroyed like Sodom and Gomorrah. \q Their land will be covered with weeds and salt pits, and it will stay empty forever. \q Those of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people who are left will take their goods, \q and the survivors of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} nation will take over their land.

es.L: Por tanto, vivo yo, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, que ciertamente Moab será como Sodoma, y los hijos de Amón como Gomorra, \q lugar poseído por ortigas, y mina de sal, y desolación para siempre; \q el remanente de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo los saqueará, \q y lo que quede de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nación los poseerá.
es.B: Por eso, vivo yo, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, que Moab llegará a ser como Sodoma, y los amonitas como Gomorra, \q tierra invadida por la maleza, un pozo de sal, un desierto para siempre. \q Lo que quede de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo los saqueará; \q los sobrevivientes de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nación se quedarán con su tierra.
es.R: Por eso, tan cierto como que yo vivo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, Moab y Amón serán destruidos como Sodoma y Gomorra. \q Su tierra se cubrirá de maleza y de pozos de sal, y quedará vacía para siempre. \q Los de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo que queden se llevarán sus bienes, \q y los sobrevivientes de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nación se apoderarán de su tierra.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi, je suis vivant, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : oui, Moab sera comme Sodome, et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Ammon comme Gomorrhe, \q un lieu possédé par les orties, une fosse de sel, une désolation pour toujours ; \q le reste de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple les pillera, \q et ce qui reste de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} nation les possédera.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi, aussi vrai que je suis vivant, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, Moab deviendra comme Sodome, et les Ammonites comme Gomorrhe, \q une terre envahie par les mauvaises herbes, une mine de sel, un désert pour toujours. \q Ce qui restera de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple les pillera ; \q les survivants de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} nation prendront leur pays.
fr.R: Alors, aussi vrai que je suis vivant, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, Moab et Ammon seront détruits comme Sodome et Gomorrhe. \q Leur pays sera couvert de mauvaises herbes et de trous de sel, et il restera vide pour toujours. \q Ceux de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple qui resteront prendront leurs biens, \q et les survivants de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} nation s’empareront de leur pays.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo, kama niishivyo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, hakika Moabu itakuwa kama Sodoma, na wana wa Amoni kama Gomora, \q mahali palipomilikiwa na upupu, na shimo la chumvi, na ukiwa milele; \q mabaki ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} watawateka nyara, \q na waliobaki wa taifa {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} watawamiliki.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo, kama niishivyo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, Moabu itakuwa kama Sodoma, na Waamoni kama Gomora, \q nchi iliyojaa magugu, shimo la chumvi, nyika ya milele. \q Waliobaki wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} watawateka nyara; \q walionusurika wa taifa {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} wataichukua nchi yao.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo, kama niishivyo hakika, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, Moabu na Amoni wataangamizwa kama Sodoma na Gomora. \q Nchi yao itafunikwa na magugu na mashimo ya chumvi, nayo itabaki tupu milele. \q Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} watakaobaki watachukua mali zao, \q na walionusurika wa taifa {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} wataitwaa nchi yao.

vi.L: Vì vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hằng sống, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên phán vậy, chắc chắn Mô-áp sẽ như Sô-đôm, và con cái Am-môn như Gô-mô-rơ, \q một nơi bị cây tầm ma chiếm cứ, một hố muối, một chốn hoang vu đời đời; \q những người sót lại của dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cướp bóc chúng, \q và phần còn lại của nước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chiếm hữu chúng.
vi.B: Vì thế, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hằng sống, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên phán vậy, Mô-áp sẽ trở nên như Sô-đôm, và người Am-môn như Gô-mô-rơ, \q một miền cỏ dại mọc tràn, một hố muối, một nơi hoang phế đời đời. \q Những người còn lại của dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cướp bóc chúng; \q những người sống sót của nước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chiếm lấy đất chúng.
vi.R: Vì vậy, thật như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hằng sống, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên phán, Mô-áp và Am-môn sẽ bị hủy diệt như Sô-đôm và Gô-mô-rơ. \q Đất của chúng sẽ đầy cỏ dại và hố muối, và sẽ bị bỏ hoang mãi mãi. \q Những người còn sót lại trong dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lấy của cải chúng, \q và những người sống sót trong nước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chiếm đất chúng.

ko.L: 그러므로 내가 살아 있음을 두고 [맹세한다]. 이스라엘의 하나님, 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 참으로 모압은 소돔처럼, 암몬 자손은 고모라처럼 되어, \q 쐐기풀이 차지한 곳, 소금 구덩이, 영원한 황무지가 될 것이다. \q 내 백성의 남은 자가 그들을 약탈하고, \q 내 민족의 나머지가 그들을 차지할 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 내가 살아 있음을 두고 맹세한다. 이스라엘의 하나님, 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 모압은 소돔처럼, 암몬 사람들은 고모라처럼 될 것이다. \q 잡초가 뒤덮은 땅, 소금 구덩이, 영원한 폐허가 될 것이다. \q 내 백성 가운데 남은 사람들이 그들을 약탈하고, \q 내 민족 가운데 살아남은 사람들이 그들의 땅을 차지할 것이다.
ko.R: 그러므로 내가 살아 있음을 두고 맹세한다. 이스라엘의 하나님, 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 모압과 암몬은 소돔과 고모라처럼 망할 것이다. \q 그 땅은 잡초와 소금 구덩이로 뒤덮이고, 영원히 텅 빈 채로 남을 것이다. \q 내 백성 가운데 살아남은 사람들이 그들의 재물을 빼앗고, \q 내 민족 가운데 살아남은 사람들이 그들의 땅을 차지할 것이다.

decisions.choice: as I live: the LORD swears by his own life
decisions.reason: People swore "as the LORD lives". The LORD, who has no one greater to swear by, swears by his own life (Numbers 14:21; Jeremiah 46:18; Ezekiel 33:11). It makes what follows certain. |

decisions.choice: like Sodom and like Gomorrah: destroyed and never rebuilt
decisions.reason: Sodom and Gomorrah were destroyed by fire from the LORD (Genesis 19:24-28) and became the pattern of total destruction (Isaiah 1:9; 13:19; Amos 4:11). Moab and Ammon were born to Lot's daughters after the fall of Sodom (Genesis 19:30-38), so their end recalls their beginning. The salt pits fit the region by the Dead Sea, where the cities were thought to lie. |

decisions.choice: a place possessed by weeds: land taken over by nettles or thorny weeds
decisions.reason: The word for the weed is rare (Job 30:7; Proverbs 24:31); it is some plant that grows on neglected ground, perhaps nettles or chickweed. The land once possessed by Moab and Ammon will be possessed by weeds. |

decisions.choice: as I live, declares the LORD of hosts (L), of Armies (B); as surely as I live, says (R)
decisions.reason: The oath follows Jeremiah 46:18 at each level, and "the LORD of hosts" follows the Isaiah table. Readable joins Moab and Ammon in one clause and says "salt pits" for "a pit of salt". |

decisions.choice: "Vivo yo, declara" (L), "Vivo yo, afirma" (B), "Tan cierto como que yo vivo, dice" (R); "el SEÑOR de los ejércitos" (L), "de los Ejércitos" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The oath follows the Spanish published in Jeremiah 46:18 at each level, and the LORD of hosts the wording set for the prophets. "Los hijos de Amón" (L) takes no gender span: "hijos" in the name of a people already includes women.

decisions.choice: "je suis vivant, déclare" (L), "aussi vrai que je suis vivant, déclare" (B), "aussi vrai que je suis vivant, dit" (R); "le SEIGNEUR des armées"
decisions.reason: The oath follows the French published in Jeremiah 46:18 at each level. "Les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d'Ammon" at Literal carries the gender setting, as in verse 8.

decisions.choice: "kama niishivyo, asema" (L, B), "kama niishivyo hakika, anasema" (R); "BWANA wa majeshi"
decisions.reason: The oath follows the Swahili published in Jeremiah 46:18 at each level. "Upupu" (L) names a stinging weed for the rare word (m3); Balanced and Readable say "magugu".

decisions.choice: "Ta hằng sống" (L, B), "thật như Ta hằng sống" (R); "CHÚA Vạn Quân" with the span on CHÚA only
decisions.reason: The oath follows the Vietnamese published in Jeremiah 46:18 at each level; "Ta" is spanned because it does not open the sentence here. "Sô-đôm" and "Gô-mô-rơ" are the published forms (Genesis 19).

decisions.choice: "내가 살아 있음을 두고 [맹세한다]" (L), "…맹세한다" (B, R); "만군의 주" (L, B), "하늘의 군대를 거느린 주" (R)
decisions.reason: The oath follows the Korean published in Jeremiah 46:18, and the formula stands as its own sentence. In God's own mouth the Readable title is 거느린, without -시-.

source.text: זֹ֥את לָהֶ֖ם תַּ֣חַת גְּאוֹנָ֑ם כִּ֤י חֵֽרְפוּ֙ וַיַּגְדִּ֔לוּ עַל־עַ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: This [will be] theirs in place of their pride, because they taunted and made [themselves] great against [the] people of Yahweh of hosts.

en.L: This [will be] theirs in return for their pride, \q because they taunted and boasted \q against the people of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts.
en.B: This is what they will get for their pride, \q because they mocked and boasted \q against the people of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.
en.R: This will happen to them because they are proud. \q They insulted and bragged \q against the people of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

es.L: Esto [será] para ellos a cambio de su soberbia, \q porque escarnecieron y se engrandecieron \q contra el pueblo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los ejércitos.
es.B: Esto es lo que recibirán por su soberbia, \q porque se burlaron y se jactaron \q contra el pueblo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.
es.R: Esto les pasará porque son orgullosos. \q Insultaron y se jactaron \q contra el pueblo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

fr.L: Cela [sera] pour eux en retour de leur orgueil, \q parce qu’ils ont outragé et se sont grandis \q contre le peuple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.B: Voilà ce qu’ils recevront pour leur orgueil, \q parce qu’ils se sont moqués et se sont vantés \q contre le peuple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: Cela leur arrivera parce qu’ils sont orgueilleux. \q Ils ont insulté et se sont vantés \q contre le peuple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées.

sw.L: Hili [litakuwa] lao badala ya kiburi chao, \q kwa sababu walidhihaki na kujikuza \q juu ya watu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.B: Hili ndilo watakalopata kwa sababu ya kiburi chao, \q kwa kuwa walidhihaki na kujigamba \q dhidi ya watu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.R: Hili litawapata kwa sababu wana kiburi. \q Walitukana na kujigamba \q dhidi ya watu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.

vi.L: Điều này [sẽ] thuộc về chúng thay cho sự kiêu ngạo của chúng, \q vì chúng đã nhục mạ và tự tôn mình lên \q nghịch cùng dân của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân.
vi.B: Đó là điều chúng phải nhận vì sự kiêu ngạo của mình, \q vì chúng đã chế nhạo và khoe khoang \q nghịch cùng dân của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân.
vi.R: Điều này sẽ xảy đến cho chúng vì chúng kiêu ngạo. \q Chúng đã sỉ nhục và khoe khoang \q nghịch cùng dân của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân.

ko.L: 이것은 그들의 교만에 대한 대가가 [될 것이다]. \q 그들이 비방하고 우쭐대며 \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 백성을 대적했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 이것은 그들이 교만한 대가로 받을 것이다. \q 그들이 조롱하고 큰소리치며 \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 백성을 대적했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그들이 교만하기 때문에 이런 일을 당할 것이다. \q 그들은 모욕하고 큰소리치며 \q 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 백성을 괴롭혔다.

decisions.choice: their pride: the arrogance of Moab and Ammon
decisions.reason: Moab's pride was well known (Isaiah 16:6; Jeremiah 48:29). The punishment answers the sin: those who made themselves great will be brought low. |

decisions.choice: the people of the LORD of hosts: the prophet now speaks of the LORD in the third person
decisions.reason: In verses 8-9 the LORD speaks ("my people"). In verses 10-11 the prophet speaks about him. Such changes of speaker are common in the prophets. |

decisions.choice: "하늘의 군대를 거느리신 주" (R), with -시-
decisions.reason: Here the prophet speaks about the LORD (m2), so the Readable title takes the honorific 거느리신, where verse 9, in God's own mouth, has 거느린.

source.text: נוֹרָ֤א יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כִּ֣י רָזָ֔ה אֵ֖ת כָּל־אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וְיִשְׁתַּֽחֲווּ־לוֹ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִמְּקוֹמ֔וֹ כֹּ֖ל אִיֵּ֥י הַגּוֹיִֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Fearsome [will be] Yahweh against them, for he will make lean all [the] gods of the earth; and they will bow down to him, each from his place, all [the] coastlands of the nations.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [will be] fearsome against them, \q for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will starve \q all the gods of the earth; \q and they will bow down to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, each from its place, \q all the coastlands of the nations.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will be fearsome to them \q when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes all the gods of the earth waste away. \q Then they will bow down to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, each in its own place, \q all the coastlands of the nations.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will fill them with fear \q when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} takes away the power of all the gods of the earth. \q Then people from every nation, even lands far away, \q will worship {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, each in their own country.

es.L: Temible [será] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} contra ellos, \q porque hará enflaquecer \q a todos los dioses de la tierra; \q y se postrarán ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, cada uno desde su lugar, \q todas las costas de las naciones.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} será temible para ellos \q cuando haga desfallecer a todos los dioses de la tierra. \q Entonces se postrarán ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, cada una en su propio lugar, \q todas las costas lejanas de las naciones.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los llenará de temor \q cuando les quite el poder a todos los dioses de la tierra. \q Entonces gente de todas las naciones, incluso de tierras lejanas, \q {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} adorará, cada uno en su propio país.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [sera] redoutable contre eux, \q car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} affamera \q tous les dieux de la terre ; \q et ils se prosterneront devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, chacun depuis son lieu, \q toutes les îles des nations.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera redoutable pour eux \q quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fera dépérir tous les dieux de la terre. \q Alors elles se prosterneront devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, chacune en son lieu, \q toutes les îles lointaines des nations.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les remplira de crainte \q quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} enlèvera tout pouvoir aux dieux de la terre. \q Alors les gens de toutes les nations, même des pays lointains, \q {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}adoreront, chacun dans son propre pays.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [atakuwa] wa kutisha juu yao, \q kwa maana ataikondesha \q miungu yote ya dunia; \q nao watamsujudia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, kila mmoja kutoka mahali pake, \q visiwa vyote vya mataifa.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa wa kutisha kwao \q atakapoifanya miungu yote ya dunia idhoofike. \q Ndipo watamsujudia, kila mmoja mahali pake, \q pwani zote za mbali za mataifa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawajaza hofu \q atakapoiondolea nguvu miungu yote ya dunia. \q Ndipo watu wa kila taifa, hata wa nchi za mbali ng'ambo ya bahari, \q watamwabudu, kila mmoja katika nchi yake.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [sẽ] đáng sợ nghịch cùng chúng, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ làm hao mòn \q tất cả các thần của đất; \q và chúng sẽ thờ lạy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, mỗi người từ chỗ mình, \q tất cả các hải đảo của các dân tộc.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đáng sợ đối với chúng \q khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho mọi thần trên đất phải tiêu hao. \q Bấy giờ mọi hải đảo của các dân tộc \q sẽ thờ lạy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, mỗi nơi tại chỗ của mình.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ làm cho chúng khiếp sợ \q khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tước hết quyền lực của mọi thần trên đất. \q Bấy giờ người thuộc mọi dân tộc, cả những miền xa bên kia biển, \q sẽ thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, ai nấy tại xứ sở mình.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들에게 두려운 분이 되실 것이다. \q 그분께서 땅의 모든 신들을 \q 여위게 하실 것이기 때문이다. \q 각자 자기 자리에서 그분께 절할 것이다, \q 민족들의 모든 섬들이.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들에게 두려운 분이 되실 것이다. \q 그분께서 땅의 모든 신들을 쇠약하게 하실 때에, \q 민족들의 모든 바닷가 나라들이 \q 각자 자기 자리에서 그분께 절할 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 두려움에 떨게 하실 것이다. \q 그분께서 땅의 모든 신들에게서 힘을 빼앗으실 때에, \q 모든 민족, 먼 나라들까지도 \q 각자 자기 나라에서 그분께 예배할 것이다.

decisions.choice: make lean: make the gods waste away
decisions.reason: The verb means "make thin, waste away" (Isaiah 17:4). The gods of the nations shrink to nothing when their worshipers turn to the LORD and their offerings stop.

decisions.choice: they will bow down to him, each from its place: the nations will worship the LORD in their own lands
decisions.reason: Elsewhere the nations come to Zion to worship (Isaiah 2:2-3; Zechariah 14:16). Here they worship the LORD where they are, as in Malachi 1:11, where incense is offered to his name "in every place". |

decisions.choice: the coastlands of the nations: the far-off lands along the sea
decisions.reason: The word means coasts and islands, and stands for the most distant lands known, to the west across the sea (Isaiah 41:1; Jeremiah 2:10). |

decisions.choice: coastlands (L, B), lands far away (R); fearsome (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Coastlands" follows the Isaiah table, with "lands far away" at Readable. The word for "fearsome" means "to be feared". Readable says "takes away the power of" for "makes waste away" (m1), and makes "each" plain as "each in their own country". |

decisions.choice: "las costas" (L), "las costas lejanas" (B), "tierras lejanas" (R)
decisions.reason: Coastlands follow the wording set for the Spanish prophets (Isaiah).

decisions.choice: "les îles" (L), "les îles lointaines" (B), "les pays lointains" (R)
decisions.reason: Coastlands follow the Isaiah table.

decisions.choice: "visiwa" (L), "pwani za mbali" (B), "nchi za mbali ng'ambo ya bahari" (R)
decisions.reason: Coastlands follow the Isaiah table. God's free pronoun "yeye" takes the span; the object marker "-m-" does not.

decisions.choice: "các hải đảo" (L, B), "những miền xa bên kia biển" (R)
decisions.reason: Coastlands follow the Isaiah table.

decisions.choice: "섬들" (L), "바닷가 나라들" (B), "먼 나라들" (R)
decisions.reason: Coastlands follow the Isaiah table. Literal keeps the Hebrew order by placing "민족들의 모든 섬들이" after the verb, as Korean poetry may do.

records.literal_gloss: Also you, Cushites: slain of my sword [are] they.

en.L: You too, Cushites, \q slain by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sword [are] they.
en.B: You too, Cushites, \q will be slain by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sword.
en.R: You people of Cush, south of Egypt, \q will also be killed by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sword.

es.L: También {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, cusitas, \q muertos por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} espada [son] ellos.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}}, gente de Cus, al sur de Egipto, \q también {{plural_you:morirán|moriréis}} a filo de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} espada.

fr.L: Vous aussi, Koushites, \q ils [sont] les tués de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} épée.
fr.B: Vous aussi, Koushites, \q vous tomberez sous {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} épée.
fr.R: Vous aussi, peuple de Koush, au sud de l’Égypte, \q vous serez tués par {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} épée.

sw.L: Nanyi pia, Wakushi, \q wao [ni] waliouawa kwa upanga {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.
sw.B: Nanyi pia, enyi Wakushi, \q mtauawa kwa upanga {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.
sw.R: Nanyi watu wa Kushi, kusini mwa Misri, \q mtauawa pia kwa upanga {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.

vi.L: Cả các ngươi nữa, hỡi người Cút, \q chúng [là] những kẻ bị gươm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giết.
vi.B: Cả các ngươi nữa, hỡi người Cút, \q các ngươi cũng sẽ bị gươm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giết chết.
vi.R: Hỡi dân Cút ở phía nam Ai Cập, \q các ngươi cũng sẽ bị giết bởi gươm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 구스 사람들아, 너희도 [그러하다]. \q 그들은 내 칼에 죽임을 당한 자들이다.
ko.B: 구스 사람들아, 너희도 \q 내 칼에 쓰러질 것이다.
ko.R: 이집트 남쪽의 구스 사람들아, \q 너희도 내 칼에 죽을 것이다.

decisions.choice: the Cushites: the people of Nubia, south of Egypt
decisions.reason: Cush lay along the Nile south of Egypt. For about fifty years before Zephaniah's time, until the Assyrians drove them out of Egypt in the 660s BC, kings from Cush ruled Egypt, so the name may stand for Egypt as well. Cush is the farthest land to the south, as Assyria (verse 13) is to the north. |

decisions.choice: you ... they: a sudden change of person
decisions.reason: The verse begins by addressing the Cushites and ends speaking of them. Such shifts are common in Hebrew poetry. The meaning is the same. |

decisions.choice: slain by my sword: killed in the LORD's judgment
decisions.reason: The LORD's sword is his judgment in battle (Isaiah 34:5-6; Jeremiah 46:10). The Cushites will fall in war, and it will be his doing. |

decisions.choice: will be slain (B), will be killed (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep the address to the Cushites throughout (m2). Readable adds where Cush was. |

decisions.choice: "cusitas", "Cus"; plural_you
decisions.reason: Cus and "cusita" are the published forms (Jeremiah 38-39). The Cushites are addressed as a people, so "you" takes the plural_you setting; Literal keeps the Hebrew switch to "they" (m2).

decisions.choice: "Koushites", "Koush"
decisions.reason: The published forms (Ébed-Mélek le Koushite, Jeremiah 38).

decisions.choice: "Wakushi", "Kushi"
decisions.reason: The published forms (Ebed-meleki Mkushi, Jeremiah 38).

decisions.choice: "người Cút", "Cút"
decisions.reason: The published forms (Ê-bết-Mê-léc người Cút, Jeremiah 38).

decisions.choice: "구스 사람들"
decisions.reason: The published form for Cush; Literal keeps the Hebrew switch from "you" to "they" (m2), supplying a verb for the first line.

source.text: וְיֵ֤ט יָדוֹ֙ עַל־צָפ֔וֹן וִֽיאַבֵּ֖ד אֶת־אַשּׁ֑וּר וְיָשֵׂ֤ם אֶת־נִֽינְוֵה֙ לִשְׁמָמָ֔ה צִיָּ֖ה כַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And he will stretch out his hand against [the] north and destroy Assyria, and he will make Nineveh a desolation, dry like the wilderness.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will stretch out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand against the north, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will destroy Assyria, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will make Nineveh a desolation, \q dry like the wilderness.
en.B: He will raise {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand against the north \q and destroy Assyria; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will turn Nineveh into a wasteland, \q as dry as the desert.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will use {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power against the north \q and destroy Assyria. \q He will turn Nineveh into a ruin, \q as dry as a desert.

es.L: Y extenderá {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano contra el norte, \q y destruirá a Asiria, \q y convertirá a Nínive en desolación, \q seca como el desierto.
es.B: Levantará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano contra el norte \q y destruirá a Asiria; \q convertirá a Nínive en una tierra desolada, \q seca como el desierto.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} usará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder contra el norte \q y destruirá a Asiria. \q Convertirá a Nínive en ruinas, \q tan seca como un desierto.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} étendra {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main contre le nord, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fera périr l’Assyrie, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fera de Ninive une désolation, \q aride comme le désert.
fr.B: Il lèvera {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main contre le nord \q et détruira l’Assyrie ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fera de Ninive un lieu désolé, \q sec comme le désert.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se servira de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance contre le nord \q et détruira l’Assyrie. \q Il fera de Ninive une ruine, \q aussi sèche qu’un désert.

sw.L: Naye atanyosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} juu ya kaskazini, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ataiangamiza Ashuru, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ataifanya Ninawi ukiwa, \q kavu kama jangwa.
sw.B: Atainua mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} dhidi ya kaskazini \q na kuiangamiza Ashuru; \q ataifanya Ninawi kuwa nyika, \q kavu kama jangwa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atatumia nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} dhidi ya kaskazini \q na kuiangamiza Ashuru. \q Ataifanya Ninawi kuwa magofu, \q kavu kama jangwa.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ giơ tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra nghịch cùng phương bắc, \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ hủy diệt A-si-ri, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ làm cho Ni-ni-ve thành hoang vu, \q khô cằn như sa mạc.
vi.B: Ngài sẽ vung tay đánh phương bắc \q và hủy diệt A-si-ri; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ biến Ni-ni-ve thành chốn hoang tàn, \q khô hạn như sa mạc.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ dùng quyền năng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghịch cùng phương bắc \q và hủy diệt A-si-ri. \q Ngài sẽ biến Ni-ni-ve thành đống đổ nát, \q khô cằn như sa mạc.

ko.L: 그분께서 북쪽을 향해 손을 뻗으셔서 \q 앗시리아를 멸하시고, \q 니느웨를 황무지로, \q 광야처럼 메마른 땅으로 만드실 것이다.
ko.B: 그분께서 북쪽을 치려고 손을 드시고 \q 앗시리아를 멸하실 것이다. \q 니느웨를 황무지로 만드시고, \q 사막처럼 메마르게 하실 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 북쪽을 향해 능력을 펼치셔서 \q 앗시리아를 멸망시키실 것이다. \q 니느웨를 폐허로 만드시고, \q 사막처럼 메마르게 하실 것이다.

decisions.choice: Assyria and Nineveh: the empire that ruled the region, and its capital
decisions.reason: Assyria had dominated Judah for a century. Nineveh, its capital on the Tigris, was taken and destroyed by the Babylonians and the Medes in 612 BC. Zephaniah speaks while it still stands; Nahum also foretells its fall. |

decisions.choice: the north: the direction from which Assyria's armies came
decisions.reason: Assyria lay to the north-east, but armies from Mesopotamia came into Judah from the north, along the fertile land, so the north stands for Assyria. |

decisions.choice: he will stretch out his hand: what the LORD will do, or a prayer that he may do it
alternatives: may he stretch out his hand
decisions.reason: The form of the verbs can be read as a statement or as a wish. Most read it as a statement, which matches verse 4 and 1:4.

decisions.choice: raise his hand (B); The LORD will use his power (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "raise his hand", the gesture of a blow. Readable names the LORD as the subject, which the verse implies, and says "use his power" for "stretch out his hand" (as at 1:4). |
